_provenance.supersedes: The Master Draft WP structure of fieldwise-run-01 (WP1 Historical Data and Target Design .. WP5 Operational Transfer, Decision Value and Web MVP, 32 tasks, D1.1-D5.5). The Pack §3.1 restructures the work plan: WP3 becomes the independent commercial-farmer prospective validation, WP4 the continuous DrR web-MVP co-development, WP5 the AgroVIR placement; MVCRI leaves the in-action plan. Task/deliverable/milestone identifiers below follow the Pack, so same-name ids (e.g. D5.1) do NOT mean the same artifact as in the superseded structure.
_provenance.partner_tokens: lead is the Pack's month-line string, verbatim. lead_role_tokens maps its names to the run-02 role tokens (HOST = HUN-REN ATK, EO_PARTNER = ELTE, DATA_PARTNER = MATE, SOFTWARE_PARTNER = Krumatic, VALIDATION_PARTNER = AgroVIR, VALIDATION_SITE = commercial farmer). The FELLOW executes all work packages in this single-researcher action; where the Pack's month line names 'Fellow' explicitly, that is recorded but the token is not repeated as a lead.
_provenance.scope_note: Work packages, month ranges, participant lines, tasks, deliverables and milestones are Pack-Confirmed. D1.3 (Career Development Plan) is operator-preserved from the CC-13 instrument mandate — it is additional to the Pack's deliverable list, unchanged in owner and due month. Task-level months are Inferred (inheritance rule stated below). Inter-WP dependency edges are Inferred with derivations stated. Person-months are operator rulings of 2026-08-28: the fellow's split ratified in session; partner in-kind figures per the effort-table ruling, all Assumed and declared.

work_packages.title: Data Harmonisation and Physiological Stress Definition

tasks.title: Audit the 2022-2026 MATE archive by variable, year, frequency and replicate structure
Define the common-variable matrix, missingness strategy and effective statistical unit
Select the primary physiological stress target and corroborating endpoints
Identify candidate soil-water, meteorological and proximal spectral stress signatures
Predefine blocked temporal validation and model-selection criteria

deliverables.title: Career Development Plan
deliverables.source_ref: Operator input pack item 6 (CC-13 instrument mandate), preserved by the 2026-08-28 baseline
deliverables.note: Not in the Pack's deliverable list; operator-preserved from the CC-13 mandate. Agreed by M3, owned by FELLOW and SUPERVISOR (now Dr. Hollós at ATK), signed by both supervisors and the fellow, reviewed at the five steering points of the re-anchored calendar (M6, M14, M18, M24, M27 — operator ruling 2026-08-28). work_packages.title: HUN-REN Modelling and ELTE Scale Harmonisation

tasks.title: Construct process-informed water-status predictors from meteorology, irrigation and soil data
Develop the parsimonious primary model and one nonlinear benchmark where justified
Quantify calibration, uncertainty, interpretability and blocked unseen-year performance
Harmonise proximal/hyperspectral information and define the valid UAV/Sentinel scale-transition strategy
Configure DrR data structures to separate reusable sensor/weather/EO/uncertainty workflows from crop-specific physiological, phenological and calibration parameters

Define the FIELDWISE crop-transfer specification: transferable core components, crop-specific parameters, minimum validation dataset and recalibration gates required before a new irrigated high-value horticultural crop can be added

deliverables.title: Primary model, benchmark and model card
Spectral/UAV/Sentinel harmonisation, scaling and crop-transfer specification

work_packages.title: Independent Commercial-Farmer Prospective Validation
work_packages.month_range_note: The Pack states 'First complete tomato growing season within M4-M18': the WP window is M4-M18 and the campaign occupies the first complete growing season inside it. A second-season extension is not planned in this structure (unlike the superseded draft's M19-M22 second-season option).

tasks.title: Secure written field access and finalise crop/measurement protocol with the established farmer collaborator
Install meteorological station and soil sensors; establish data-quality and irrigation-recording procedures
Conduct coordinated physiological, proximal spectral and thermal measurement campaigns
Conduct UAV campaigns around key measurement dates and acquire/synchronise Sentinel-2 observations where spatially valid
Apply the historical model prospectively, quantify the transfer gap and evaluate limited recalibration only where required
Activate the Szentendre Skanzen contingency option only if primary-site access fails and formal suitability/agreement are secured

deliverables.title: Prospective transferability, uncertainty and limited-recalibration report

work_packages.title: DrR Web MVP, Co-development and Exploitation Preparation

tasks.title: Krumatic incrementally improves the existing prototype and implements validated data/model functions
Implement a crop-configurable architecture integrating stress probability/class, uncertainty, temporal trend and irrigation-attention outputs while keeping crop-specific parameters explicit
Migrate validated core functions toward the DrR web MVP
Use structured AgroVIR consultation from M1 to review realistic farm inputs, usability and interoperability requirements
Perform pre-placement external access testing and prepare the M25-M30 evaluation protocol
Maintain data/IP/background/foreground inventory and define the post-MSCA exploitation route

deliverables.title: Crop-configurable DrR web MVP with validated processing-tomato module and reusable core functions

deliverable_sequencing_check.statement: D4.1, the crop-configurable web MVP, lands at MS4 (M24), before the M25-M30 placement begins, so the placement is evaluation and transfer rather than first build.
deliverable_sequencing_check.note: The Pack builds the sequencing in structurally: MS4 (M24) is 'MVP ready for industrial placement evaluation' and WP5 is the evaluation. This retires the D5.1-timing check of the superseded structure — the constraint is now carried by the milestone definition itself. Phase 4 owns deliverable due months and must not schedule D4.1 or D4.2 into M25-M30.

cross_cutting_strands.note: The Pack's indicative 30-month sequence carries three continuous strands across M1-M30 that are not work packages: Training / two-way transfer; Management / Open Science / IP; Dissemination / exploitation. They correspond to the cross-cutting person-month row below.

task_month_allocation.note: The Pack gives month ranges per work package but no task-level months. Derivation: each task inherits its work package's full month range, which adds no information the Pack does not state. Phase 4 narrows tasks to months; this seed deliberately does not pre-empt that. Exceptions: none — every task uses the inherited range. T3.1 (written access) and T3.2 (installation) naturally precede the measurement campaign inside WP3's window, and T4.5 (pre-placement testing) naturally sits late in WP4; those narrowings belong to Phase 4 and are indicated, not encoded.

dependencies.note: Derived: WP2's process-informed predictors (T2.1) and primary model (T2.2) operate on the common-variable matrix and stress target WP1 defines (T1.2, T1.3), and MS1 is the readiness statement. Month ranges overlap (WP2 starts M3), so this is a data dependency, not strict sequencing.
Derived: T1.5 predefines the blocked temporal validation and model-selection criteria the prospective campaign measures against, and D1.2 is the protocol T3.3's campaigns follow.

Derived: T3.5 'apply the historical model prospectively' requires the WP2 model to exist; the WP3 campaign itself (T3.2-T3.4) can begin before the model is final, so the hard dependency binds T3.5, not WP3's start.

Derived: WP4's crop-configurable architecture (T4.2) implements the reusable/crop-specific separation WP2 configures (T2.5) and the crop-transfer specification (T2.6). WP4 starts M1 on the existing prototype, so the edge binds the architecture work, not the WP start.

dependencies.source_ref: Pack §3.1 T4.3, D4.1; §1.1.3 ('only validated scientific components will then be progressively incorporated')
dependencies.note: Derived: D4.1's 'validated processing-tomato module' requires the WP3 prospective validation; T4.3 migrates validated core functions. The software-follows-the-science principle (Pack §1.1.3) is the governing statement.

Derived: MS4 (M24) is 'MVP ready for industrial placement evaluation' and T4.5 prepares the M25-M30 evaluation protocol; WP5 evaluates what WP4 delivers. Strict sequencing: WP5 starts the month after WP4 ends.

person_months.note: Operator rulings of 2026-08-28 (baseline record). The fellow's split was ratified in session against the new WP structure; the Pack states no split, so the figures are the operator's decision, not a Pack lift. Partner effort is in kind, is not funded by MSCA-PF and is not costed by the unit-cost derivation; all five partner figures are operator estimates, Assumed with matching declarations in working_assumptions.json.

fellow_allocation.total_check: Equals project_duration_months in call_binding/selected_call.json. The fellow is the only MSCA-funded effort in this single-researcher action.
fellow_allocation.placement_window_check: M25-M30 carries WP5 at 5.4 plus the cross-cutting strand's uniform share (3.0 x 6/30 = 0.6), totalling exactly 6.0 person-months over six months — 1.0 FTE, no overcommitment.
fellow_allocation.cross_cutting_note: The cross-cutting row is not a work package and has no id in work_packages above. It corresponds to the Pack's three continuous strands (training/two-way transfer; management/Open Science/IP; dissemination/exploitation) and covers the whole action.

partner_in_kind_effort.note: All five figures are operator estimates of the 2026-08-28 effort-table ruling (role-for-role swap), to be checked with the partners. None is costed: MSCA-PF funds only the fellow's months. Each carries a declaration in working_assumptions.json under the key named per entry. MVCRI's former 1.5 PM seat is removed (post-MSCA route).

open_consequences_for_phase_4: M4-M14 carries WP1 tail, WP2, WP3 and WP4 concurrently; the ratified totals fit inside 30 person-months over 30 months, and phase_04_gate's concurrency check over task months is the arbiter.
The placement window M25-M30 is exactly 1.0 FTE by construction (5.4 + 0.6); Phase 4 must not add task months there.
